QuestInfo.name: Making Red Jade
QuestInfo.0: Looks like you need to get a #t4032312# for #p1201002# once again. But you don't even know where to start. Shouldn't #b#p1201000##k know something about this?
QuestInfo.1: #p1201000# told you that if you use the Mirror of Desire in #m140030000#, you can learn how to get a #t4032312#. As expected, this is your only option. Go to #b#m140030000##k. \n\n#i4032312# #t4032312# #b#c4032312# / 1#k
QuestInfo.2: You brought the #t4032312# that you saw in the Mirror of Desire, and it seems that #p1201002# is satisfied with the result. With help from #p1201002#'s skill with jewels, a little bit of the power you once had has returned.

0.0: What happened this time? Hmmm, so you need the polearm's gem? My goodness, that weapon definitely has an attitude, but you can't ignore its pleas either....
0.1: #t4032312# is probably a gem that has the power to exponentially expand the weapon's powers, which means you'll have to cater to its wishes and get a #t4032312# as it wishes.
0.2: What? You don't know how? That's easy! This is directly related to you, you have a specific target, and you even have a specific wish. That means you can use the #bMirror of Desire#k! Go ahead!
0.3: You didn't forget where the Mirror of Desire is, did you? You'll find it inside the #m140030000# on Ice Cliff. Ice Cliff is left out of town, as far as you can go. The #b#t4032312##k is there.\r\n\r\n#b(When you accept, you will be moved to #m140030000#.)#k

no.0: ...Eh? What is it? Are there side effects to using the Mirror of Desire? Or do you really not like anything that seems to have to do with the occult? I refuse to put up with whiners!

npc.0: Still not able to find what the polearm wanted? I'm telling you, the Mirror of Desire will tell you exactly where it is! Don't tell me you forgot how to get to #m140030000#. Just head all the way west past town.

item.0: A master who'd forgotten how to make a #b#t4032312##k...?! I can't believe I am owned by this 'hero.' No reason to dream, no reason to hope... *Sigh*
